title: GOV-0005: badf init's intent contract exists only in code
problem:
## Observed
`INTENT_REQUIRED` (now 7 fields: `name`, `intent`, `owner`, `target`, `repository`, `local_path`, `demand`) and `INTENT_TARGETS` are defined only in `scripts/badf_gate.py`. No README section, no `docs/` page and no `examples/` file describes the intent file a human writes for `badf init`. Issue #22 itself had to read the code to learn the field set, and the demand field added by BADF-WP-0018 is documented in the doctrine's *Demand records* section but not on any intent surface.

## Expected
The contract a human writes to is documented on a surface that carries it, with an example intent — and a drift test asserting the documented field list equals `INTENT_REQUIRED`, so the document cannot silently fall behind the code (the same pattern the schema-drift tests use for `DOSSIER_FIELDS` and friends).

## Evidence
`grep -rnE "local_path|intent\.project|badf init" docs README.md examples` → no matches on `main` at the merge of #23.

## Unknowns
Whether the intent example should live in `examples/` (locked? — see GOV-0004 for the same question about `schemas/`) or in `docs/`.

## Proposed work package
Patch tier: a `badf init` section (README or `docs/`), `examples/intent.yaml`, and `test_badf_init_docs_match_code` comparing the documented fields to `INTENT_REQUIRED` and `INTENT_TARGETS`.

discovered-by: BADF-WP-0018 · status: DISCOVERED
